_readme: Single source of truth for every legal, contact and pricing fact on the site. Anything marked FILL_ME must be filled in before the site will build. See build.js. Change a value here and every page that mentions it updates on the next build.

databases.textLong: MongoDB, PostgreSQL or MariaDB, which is MySQL
databases.note: Pick whichever your project needs. It runs on the same machine as your application, so a query is a loopback call and never crosses the internet.

vector.short: Vector search is included. PostgreSQL ships with pgvector switched on.
vector.why: A separate vector database would want its own memory and its own bill. pgvector is an extension rather than another service, so your embeddings sit in the same database as the rest of your data and cost nothing extra.

limits.imagesText: the build you are running and the one before it
limits.storageNote: Storage covers everything the application owns: your code, your uploads and your database, counted together.

runtimes.detectedText: Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP and .NET
runtimes.note: We read your repository and work out how to build it. If your language is not on that list, or you want the build done your way, add a Dockerfile and we build that instead. Rust, Elixir, Deno, Bun, C++, anything that starts and listens on a port.

company.operatedBy: This website is operated by Rohit Mahto, a sole proprietor trading as DormHost.

gst.statement: DormHost is not registered for GST. The price you see is the full amount charged. No tax is added at checkout.

refund.mode: the original payment method, meaning the same UPI ID, card or bank account you paid from

payments.methods: UPI, debit card, credit card and net banking
payments.currencyNote: Customers in India are charged in Indian Rupees (INR, ₹). Everyone else is charged in US Dollars (USD, $). The price you are shown at checkout is the price you pay, and nothing is converted afterwards.

plans.name: Nap
plans.summary: The usual choice. Sleeps when nobody is using it.
plans.description: Hosting for one web application in any language, deployed from a public or private GitHub repository. Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP and .NET are detected and built automatically; anything else builds from a Dockerfile in your repository. Includes a database on the same machine as the app, MongoDB, PostgreSQL or MariaDB as you prefer, an HTTPS address at yourname.dormhost.app, support for a custom domain, 512 MB of memory, nightly database backups kept for seven days, 5 GB of storage covering code, uploads and database together, and a choice of Mumbai or London. The application is stopped after fifteen minutes with no visitors and started again by the next request, typically in about 200 milliseconds.
features: Automatic builds for Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP and .NET
Or bring your own Dockerfile for anything else
MongoDB, PostgreSQL or MariaDB, on the same machine
pgvector on PostgreSQL for embeddings and similarity search
Build logs, and rollback to your previous build
Sleeps after 15 minutes idle, wakes on the next request

plans.name: Awake
plans.summary: Never sleeps. For bots, workers and cron jobs.
plans.description: Everything in the Nap plan, with the application kept running at all times instead of being stopped when idle. Intended for workloads that cannot be paused: Discord and Telegram bots, scheduled jobs, queue workers, and anything holding a long-lived connection. Any language, built automatically or from your own Dockerfile. Includes the same choice of MongoDB, PostgreSQL or MariaDB database, 512 MB of memory, 10 GB of storage covering code, uploads and database together, custom domain support, nightly backups and a choice of Mumbai or London.
features: Never sleeps, so the process stays running
For Discord bots, cron jobs and queue workers
Any language, or your own Dockerfile

annual.note: Pay for ten months, get twelve. Yearly plans can be cancelled at any time and refunded under the refund policy.
